recentItems.title: PC Gaming Show Tokyo Direct 2026: Co-stream
recentItems.description:
Tune in on September 20th for the PC Gaming Show Tokyo Direct 2026. Broadcasting from Tokyo Games Show, expect to see the latest trailers, world premiere game announcements, behind the scenes developer interviews, and the biggest features on the floor of TGS. 

Hosted by the illustrious Frankie Ward, the showcase will include 35+ of the most exciting games in development. We have plenty of surprises in store so don’t miss out! For all the games featured in the show, head on over to pcgamer.com/wishlist

The PC Gaming Show Tokyo Direct will broadcast here on YouTube, as well as all major streaming platforms, on September 20th at 9am PT, 12 noon ET, 5pm BST and 1am JST. For more information, visit the official site at pcgamingshow.com.
